svg.title: OpenShift 4.22 Cross-Cluster EVPN L2 Lab Topology
svg.desc: Two OpenShift 4.22 clusters with seven nodes each. Site A VM at 10.250.50.3 and VTEP 10.251.10.15 communicates with Site B VM at 10.250.50.4 and VTEP 10.251.20.24 over EVPN VXLAN. Each cluster peers with its local FRR bastion using eBGP. The bastions peer using iBGP across encrypted SSH tun7.
svg.text: OpenShift 4.22 Cross-Cluster EVPN L2 Lab Topology
Two OpenShift clusters connected using BGP EVPN over routed inter-site transport
Lab demonstration: the VXLAN overlay follows the routed bastion-to-bastion SSH underlay; it is not a direct physical link.
